#advancement reset
advancement revoke @s only damage:blunt

#hit count add
scoreboard players add @s bluntC 1

#temp tag (+)
tag @s add temp_blunt

##stat记录最新的受伤类型 damage记录受到该类型伤害的总值

##回复记录值

scoreboard players set @s explode_degree 0

#钝伤

scoreboard players set @s sharpC 0
scoreboard players set @s bluntC 0

##血量记录

execute store result score @s HPmax run attribute @s max_health base get
#总HP记录
scoreboard players operation @s HPsave = @s HPmax

scoreboard players set @s fall_damage 0
#player
scoreboard players set @s player_damage 0

scoreboard players set @s projectile_damage 0

scoreboard players set @s explode_damage 0

scoreboard players set @s burn_damage 0
#freeze
scoreboard players set @s freeze_damage 0
#drown
scoreboard players set @s drown_damage 0
#inwall
scoreboard players set @s inwall_damage 0
#others
scoreboard players set @s shock_damage 0

#bleed
scoreboard players set @s bleed_damage 0

##受伤效果重置
execute as @a run function damage:damages/fall_damage/fall_clear
execute as @a run function damage:damages/burn_damage/burn_clear
execute as @a run function damage:damages/explode_damage/explode_clear
execute as @a run function damage:damages/drown_damage/drown_clear
execute as @a run function damage:damages/shock_damage/shock_clear
execute as @a run function damage:damages/drown_damage/drown_clear
execute as @a run function damage:damages/inwall_damage/inwall_clear

##

#tag
tag @s remove temp_sharp
tag @s remove temp_blunt

##stat记录最新的受伤类型 damage记录受到该类型伤害的总值

#触电状态
scoreboard players set @s shock_stat 0
scoreboard players set @s shock_degree 0
#其它
scoreboard players set @s other_stat 0

scoreboard players set @s hemorrhagic_degree 0

#钝伤

scoreboard players set @s blunt_degree 0

##受击次数
scoreboard players set @s sharpC 0

##血量记录

execute store result score @s HPmax run attribute @s max_health base get
#总HP记录
scoreboard players operation @s HPsave = @s HPmax
#fall
scoreboard players set @s fall_damage 0
#player
scoreboard players set @s player_damage 0
#projectile
scoreboard players set @s projectile_damage 0
#explode
scoreboard players set @s explode_damage 0
#burn
scoreboard players set @s burn_damage 0
#freeze
scoreboard players set @s freeze_damage 0
#drown
scoreboard players set @s drown_damage 0
#inwall

scoreboard players set @s shock_damage 0

##受伤效果重置
execute as @a run function damage:damages/fall_damage/fall_clear
execute as @a run function damage:damages/burn_damage/burn_clear
execute as @a run function damage:damages/explode_damage/explode_clear
execute as @a run function damage:damages/drown_damage/drown_clear
execute as @a run function damage:damages/shock_damage/shock_clear
execute as @a run function damage:damages/drown_damage/drown_clear
execute as @a run function damage:damages/inwall_damage/inwall_clear

#tag
tag @s remove temp_sharp
tag @s remove temp_blunt

tellraw @s[scores={bleed_degree=1..}] [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『出血』",color:dark_red,italic:true,bold:true},{text:" 已停止！",color:green,italic:true,bold:false}]
execute as @s[scores={bleed_degree=1..}] at @s run playsound manosaba:notice ambient @s ~ ~ ~ 0.5
#degree reset
scoreboard players set @s bleed_degree 0
scoreboard players set @s bleed_minus 0
scoreboard players set @s bleed_stat 0
scoreboard players set @s hemorrhagic_degree 0

##every 5t

#bleed effection
execute as @a[scores={ready=1,dead=0,bleed_degree=1..,bleed_minus=0}] at @s run function damage:damages/bleed_damage/bleeding

#reset
scoreboard players set @a[scores={ready=1,dead=0,bleed_degree=1,bleed_minus=0}] bleed_minus 16
scoreboard players set @a[scores={ready=1,dead=0,bleed_degree=2,bleed_minus=0}] bleed_minus 10
scoreboard players set @a[scores={ready=1,dead=0,bleed_degree=3,bleed_minus=0}] bleed_minus 4
scoreboard players set @a[scores={ready=1,dead=0,bleed_degree=4,bleed_minus=0}] bleed_minus 1
#minus
scoreboard players remove @a[scores={ready=1,dead=0,bleed_degree=1..,bleed_minus=1..}] bleed_minus 1

#初次受伤提示
execute unless entity @s[scores={hemorrhagic_degree=1}] run tellraw @s [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『休克 I 级』",color:dark_purple,italic:true,bold:true,hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:[{text:"你感到轻微头晕，四肢活动不利",color:gray}]}}]
#effection
effect give @s slowness 6 0 true
effect give @s nausea 5 0 true
effect give @s mining_fatigue 6 2 true
#degree set
scoreboard players set @s hemorrhagic_degree 1

#初次受伤提示
execute unless entity @s[scores={hemorrhagic_degree=2}] run tellraw @s [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『休克 II 级』",color:dark_purple,italic:true,bold:true,hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:[{text:"你感到头晕，四肢麻木",color:gray}]}}]
#effection
effect give @s slowness 14 1 true
effect give @s nausea 14 0 true
effect give @s mining_fatigue 14 4 true
#degree set
scoreboard players set @s hemorrhagic_degree 2

#初次受伤提示
execute unless entity @s[scores={hemorrhagic_degree=3}] run tellraw @s [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『休克 III 级』",color:dark_purple,italic:true,bold:true,hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:[{text:"你感到意识昏沉，四肢麻木，视线模糊",color:gray}]}}]
#effection
effect give @s slowness 30 2 true
effect give @s nausea 30 0 true
effect give @s mining_fatigue 30 6 true
effect give @s darkness 30 0 true
effect give @s blindness 30 0 true
#degree set
scoreboard players set @s hemorrhagic_degree 3

#unready return
execute unless entity @s[scores={ready=1,dead=0,Playing=1}] run return fail

#tag -
tag @s remove temp_sharp

#stat test
scoreboard players add @s[scores={bleed_degree=1..,playerdmg_stat=3..5}] bleed_degree 1
scoreboard players add @s[scores={bleed_degree=0,playerdmg_stat=1..5}] bleed_degree 1
scoreboard players add @s[scores={playerdmg_stat=6..10}] bleed_degree 2
scoreboard players add @s[scores={playerdmg_stat=11..15}] bleed_degree 3
scoreboard players add @s[scores={playerdmg_stat=16..}] bleed_degree 4
#legal check
scoreboard players set @s[scores={bleed_degree=5..}] bleed_degree 4

#tellback
tellraw @s[scores={bleed_degree=1}] [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『浅表出血 I』",color:dark_red,italic:true,bold:true,hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:[{text:"浅表性出血，缓慢损失生命值，容易自愈",color:gray}]}}]
tellraw @s[scores={bleed_degree=2}] [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『浅表出血 II』",color:dark_red,italic:true,bold:true,hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:[{text:"浅表性出血，缓慢损失生命值，较容易自愈",color:gray}]}}]
tellraw @s[scores={bleed_degree=3}] [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『静脉出血』",color:dark_red,italic:true,bold:true,hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:[{text:"中小静脉破损所致出血，较快损失生命值，难以自愈",color:gray}]}}]
tellraw @s[scores={bleed_degree=4}] [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『大出血』",color:dark_red,italic:true,bold:true,hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:[{text:"大血管破裂所致的出血，缓慢损失生命值，几乎不可能自愈",color:gray}]}}]

#bleed_stat (+)
scoreboard players set @s bleed_stat 160

##流血效果

#stat
scoreboard players remove @s[scores={bleed_degree=1}] bleed_stat 16
scoreboard players remove @s[scores={bleed_degree=2}] bleed_stat 8
scoreboard players remove @s[scores={bleed_degree=3}] bleed_stat 1
scoreboard players remove @s[scores={bleed_degree=4}] bleed_stat 1

#motion random
execute store result score @s bleedMotionX run random value -10..10
execute store result score @s bleedMotionZ run random value -10..10

#blood summon
execute positioned ~ ~2.5 ~ run function clues:blood/drop/blood_summon

#motion edit
execute store result entity @e[type=armor_stand,tag=blood_dropping,limit=1,sort=nearest] Motion[0] float 0.01 run scoreboard players get @s bleedMotionX
execute store result entity @e[type=armor_stand,tag=blood_dropping,limit=1,sort=nearest] Motion[2] float 0.01 run scoreboard players get @s bleedMotionZ

##effection
#damage score
scoreboard players add @s bleed_damage 1
#damage
damage @s 0.5 damage:extra_damage

#hemorrhagic check
function damage:damages/bleed_damage/hemorrhagic_degree

#cure test
execute as @s[scores={bleed_stat=..0}] run function damage:damages/bleed_damage/bleed_clear

#score reset
# scoreboard players reset @s bleedMotionX
# scoreboard players reset @s bleedMotionZ

#cure text
tellraw @s [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『休克』",color:dark_purple,italic:true,bold:true},{text:" 已结束！",color:green,italic:true,bold:false}]
execute as @s at @s run playsound manosaba:notice ambient @s ~ ~ ~ 0.5
#score
scoreboard players set @s hemorrhagic_degree 0

##出血程度判定
execute as @s[scores={bleed_damage=16..24}] run function damage:damages/bleed_damage/bleed_mild
execute as @s[scores={bleed_damage=25..32}] run function damage:damages/bleed_damage/bleed_moderate
execute as @s[scores={bleed_damage=33..}] run function damage:damages/bleed_damage/bleed_severe

##自调用组件 --游戏开始时调用

#hemorrhagic reset
execute as @a[scores={ready=1,dead=0,bleed_damage=0,hemorrhagic_degree=1..}] run function damage:damages/bleed_damage/hemorrhagic_cure

#condition-func
execute as @a[scores={ready=1,dead=0,bleed_damage=1..}] run function damage:damages/bleed_damage/hemorrhagic_degree

#自调用
execute if score manosaba:data Gaming matches 1 run schedule function damage:damages/bleed_damage/hemorrhagic_progress 5s

##prob check 接收参数 $(stat) -钝伤概率
#随机数
execute store result score #bluntProb blunt_stat run random value 1..100

#condition
$execute unless score #bluntProb blunt_stat matches 1..$(stat) run return fail

##effect assign
execute if score @s blunt_degree matches 3 run function damage:damages/blunt_damage/blunt_severe with storage damage:blunt
execute if score @s blunt_degree matches 2 run function damage:damages/blunt_damage/blunt_moderate with storage damage:blunt
execute if score @s blunt_degree matches 1 run function damage:damages/blunt_damage/blunt_mild with storage damage:blunt

attribute @s movement_speed modifier remove manosaba:blunt
attribute @s minecraft:jump_strength modifier remove manosaba:blunt
scoreboard players set @s blunt_minus 0

##自调用组件

#minus
scoreboard players remove @a[scores={ready=1,dead=0,blunt_minus=1..}] blunt_minus 1
#attribute clear
execute as @a[scores={ready=1,dead=0,blunt_minus=0}] run function damage:damages/blunt_damage/blunt_severe_clear

#自调用
execute if entity @a[scores={ready=1,dead=0,blunt_minus=1..}] run schedule function damage:damages/blunt_damage/blunt_cycle 1s

#tellback
tellraw @s [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『钝伤 I』",color:dark_gray,italic:true,bold:true,hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:[{text:"头部受到钝性冲击，轻微眩晕",color:gray}]}}]
#effection
effect give @s slowness 6 0 true
effect give @s nausea 8 0 true
effect give @s blindness 1 0 true
effect give @s darkness 2 0 true

#tellback
tellraw @s [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『钝伤 II』",color:dark_gray,italic:true,bold:true,hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:[{text:"头部受到钝性冲击，眩晕，意识恍惚",color:gray}]}}]
#effection
effect give @s slowness 10 1 true
effect give @s nausea 15 0 true
effect give @s darkness 5 0 true
effect give @s blindness 5 0 true

##自调用 看地板

execute as @a[scores={blunt_minus=1..}] at @s run tp @s ~ ~ ~ facing ~ ~-1 ~

#自调用
execute if entity @a[scores={blunt_minus=1..}] run schedule function damage:damages/blunt_damage/blunt_seeground 1t

#tellback
tellraw @s [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『钝伤 III』",color:dark_gray,italic:true,bold:true,hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:[{text:"头部受到钝性冲击，短暂失去意识",color:gray}]}}]
#effection
effect give @s slowness 15 2 true
effect give @s nausea 23 0 true
effect give @s darkness 13 4 true
effect give @s blindness 13 4 true
#attribute
attribute @s movement_speed modifier add manosaba:blunt -10 add_value
attribute @s jump_strength modifier add manosaba:blunt -10 add_value
#score
scoreboard players set @s blunt_minus 7
#cycle
function damage:damages/blunt_damage/blunt_seeground
schedule function damage:damages/blunt_damage/blunt_cycle 1s replace

#attribute
attribute @s movement_speed modifier remove manosaba:blunt
attribute @s jump_strength modifier remove manosaba:blunt

#unready return
execute unless entity @s[scores={ready=1,dead=0,Playing=1}] run return fail

#tag -
tag @s remove temp_blunt

#stat test
scoreboard players operation @s blunt_stat = @s playerdmg_stat
#const
scoreboard players set #blunt1 blunt_stat 5
scoreboard players set #blunt2 blunt_stat 8
scoreboard players set #blunt3 blunt_stat 10

##lv3
execute if score @s blunt_stat matches 11.. run scoreboard players set @s blunt_degree 3
execute if score @s blunt_degree matches 3 run scoreboard players operation @s blunt_stat *= #blunt1 blunt_stat
##lv2
execute if score @s blunt_stat matches 8..10 run scoreboard players set @s blunt_degree 2
execute if score @s blunt_degree matches 2 run scoreboard players operation @s blunt_stat *= #blunt2 blunt_stat
##lv1
execute if score @s blunt_stat matches 3..7 run scoreboard players set @s blunt_degree 1
execute if score @s blunt_degree matches 1 run scoreboard players operation @s blunt_stat *= #blunt3 blunt_stat
#storage stat
execute store result storage damage:blunt stat int 1.0 run scoreboard players get @s blunt_stat

#func assign
function damage:damages/blunt_damage/blunt_assign with storage damage:blunt

#score reset
scoreboard players set #bluntProb blunt_stat 0
scoreboard players set @s blunt_degree 0
#storage clear
data remove storage damage:blunt stat

tellraw @s[scores={burn_degree=1..}] [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『灼伤』",color:gold,italic:true,bold:true},{text:" 已痊愈！",color:green,italic:true,bold:false}]
execute as @s[scores={burn_degree=1..}] at @s run playsound manosaba:notice ambient @s ~ ~ ~ 0.5
#degree reset
scoreboard players set @s burn_degree 0

##受伤程度判定 --仅受伤时调用
execute as @s[scores={burn_damage=5..8}] run function damage:damages/burn_damage/burn_mild
execute as @s[scores={burn_damage=9..14}] run function damage:damages/burn_damage/burn_moderate
execute as @s[scores={burn_damage=15..}] run function damage:damages/burn_damage/burn_severe

#初次受伤提示
execute unless entity @s[scores={burn_degree=1}] run tellraw @s [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『灼伤 I 级』",color:gold,italic:true,bold:true,hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:[{text:"在该异常状态被治愈前受伤将会受到额外的",color:gray},{text:" 1点 ",color:"#FFF8AE"},{text:"追加伤害",color:light_purple}]}}]
damage @s 1 damage:extra_damage
execute at @s run playsound entity.generic.extinguish_fire ambient @a ~ ~ ~ 0.5 2
scoreboard players set @s burn_degree 1

#初次受伤提示
execute unless entity @s[scores={burn_degree=2}] run tellraw @s [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『灼伤 II 级』",color:gold,italic:true,bold:true,hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:[{text:"在该异常状态被治愈前受伤将会受到额外的",color:gray},{text:" 1.5点 ",color:"#FFF8AE"},{text:"追加伤害",color:light_purple}]}}]
damage @s 1.5 damage:extra_damage
execute at @s run playsound entity.generic.extinguish_fire ambient @a ~ ~ ~ 0.5 2
scoreboard players set @s burn_degree 2

#初次受伤提示
execute unless entity @s[scores={burn_degree=3}] run tellraw @s [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『灼伤 III 级』",color:gold,italic:true,bold:true,hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:[{text:"在该异常状态被治愈前受伤将会受到额外的",color:gray},{text:" 2点 ",color:"#FFF8AE"},{text:"追加伤害",color:light_purple}]}}]
damage @s 2 damage:extra_damage
execute at @s run playsound entity.generic.extinguish_fire ambient @a ~ ~ ~ 0.5 2
scoreboard players set @s burn_degree 3

execute as @a[tag=temp_burn] run function damage:damages/burn_damage/burndmg_save
#tag remove
tag @a[tag=temp_burn] remove temp_burn

#advancement reset
advancement revoke @s only damage:burn_test

#unready return
execute unless entity @s[scores={ready=1,dead=0,Playing=1}] run return fail

#save condition
execute unless entity @s[scores={ready=1,dead=0}] run return fail
#temp tag(+)
tag @s add temp_burn
#schedule save
schedule function damage:damages/burn_damage/burn_start 2t replace

#if dead
execute if entity @s[scores={ready=1,dead=1,burn_damage=0}] run scoreboard players operation @s burn_stat = @s HPsave
execute if entity @s[scores={ready=1,dead=1,burn_damage=0}] run return run scoreboard players operation @s burn_damage = @s HPsave
execute if entity @s[scores={ready=1,dead=1,burn_damage=1..}] run return run scoreboard players set @s burn_stat 1
#stat refresh
function damage:stat_reset
#stat calc.
scoreboard players operation @s burn_stat = @s HPsave
scoreboard players operation @s burn_stat -= @s HP
#legal check
execute if entity @s[scores={burn_stat=..-1}] run scoreboard players set @s burn_stat 0
#damage cast
scoreboard players operation @s burn_damage += @s burn_stat
#damage legal check
execute if entity @s[scores={burn_damage=21..}] run scoreboard players set @s burn_damage 20
#burn degree check
function damage:damages/burn_damage/burn_degree
#witchprog cast
scoreboard players operation @s dwitchProg += @s burn_stat
scoreboard players operation @s dwitchProg += @s burn_stat
scoreboard players operation @s dwitchProg += @s burn_stat
#end
scoreboard players operation @s HPsave = @s HP

#degree reset
scoreboard players set @s drown_degree 0

##受伤程度判定 --仅受伤时调用
execute as @s[scores={drown_damage=3..8}] run function damage:damages/drown_damage/drown_mild
execute as @s[scores={drown_damage=9..14}] run function damage:damages/drown_damage/drown_moderate
execute as @s[scores={drown_damage=15..}] run function damage:damages/drown_damage/drown_severe

#初次受伤提示
execute unless entity @s[scores={drown_degree=1}] run tellraw @s [{text:"* ",color:white,italic:false},{text:"异常状态:",color:yellow,italic:true},{text:"『溺水 I 级』",color:blue,italic:true,bold:true,hover_event:{action:"show_text",value:[{text:"该异常状态将使你感到四肢轻微无力",color:gray}]}}]
effect give @s slowness 5 1 true
effect give @s mining_fatigue 5 2 true
scoreboard players set @s drown_degree 1

#初次受伤提示

# 囚庭演定 教程文本
『』
## warden said
1. cam1
    咳咳...
    下面就让我这可爱的猫头鹰来给你介绍一下 『囚庭演定』 玩法吧
    (将指针悬停在带有 下划线 的文本上能够看到其注释)
    在 『囚庭演定』 中，一共有三个阵营，『魔女阵营』、『预备魔女阵营』、『杀意魔女阵营』*由高压力的预备魔女转化而来*
    『魔女阵营』中分为『魔女』与『共犯』两种身份
    『魔女』在游戏开始3min后可获得一把 『仪礼剑』，而『共犯』无自带的攻击手段 *冷却3分钟，激活后可作为武器使用10秒，20攻击力，有攻击冷却*
    『魔女阵营』的获胜目标是将所有非本阵营的玩家全部杀死，真是残忍呢，呵呵...

    『预备魔女』阵营的获胜目标是完成地图中的任务，获取越狱进度并达到100%；亦或是场上不再存在其它两个阵营的玩家时获胜

    『杀意魔女』由低『意志力』的『预备魔女』概率转化而来 *玩家基础属性，玩家经历可影响其数值，之后会详述*
    其获胜目标是杀死除了自己以外的所有玩家

2. cam2
    接下来介绍玩家的基本属性
    在游戏开始时每名玩家会随机获取一组 **不重复** 的魔法
    除了被选为『魔女』的玩家外，每组魔法的第二技能初始为锁定状态
    需要意志力低到一定程度后才可解锁
    玩家使用魔法需要消耗魔力值，魔力值的『自然恢复上限』为100 *玩家魔力值小于100时，每秒可恢复4点MP，魔力值上无封顶*
    除了魔法以外，玩家还有一定概率能够从三项天赋中选择一项，获得一些特殊的效果
    意志力则会实时根据玩家的游戏行为进行改变
    意志力降至50%以下时，便会开始概率受到『低意志影响』，预备魔女还有可能转化为『杀意魔女』 *概率获得各种匪夷所思的debuff，意志力越低概率越高，影响越严重*
    不过，意志力低也会使得大部分魔法的效果得到强化，意志力越低，魔法效果越强

3. cam3
    接下来是地图的探索系统
    游戏开始后，手持快捷栏中的地图即可查看地图，单击右键以切换地图位面
    所有玩家都会收到随机分配的日常任务，完成即可获得相应的奖励，预备魔女还可获得越狱进度值
    快捷栏中的放大镜为地图交互道具，对准可交互点『长按右键』即可调查该交互点 *有时交互点在例如木桶等可被右键的方块上时\n按下shift即可正常使用放大镜*
    地图中的可交互点/物件将会以发光点的形式标记
    另外，靠近玩家死亡后留下的遗体打开背包，点击背包中的搜索遗体物品即可搜索遗体物品
    探索得到的各种饰品能够放进背包中对应颜色的『饰品栏』，并获得对应效果
    调查可调查掉落物(如针管、损坏的武器等)得到的线索道具能够存入背包中的『线索栏』中，在庭审环节时打开背包单击即可出示

4. cam4
    当一具『未确认死亡』的玩家遗体被任意玩家调查时，将暂停所有任务，进入调查阶段 *在进入魔女审判前，玩家列表无法看到有哪些玩家已经死亡，这些玩家即为未确认死亡状态*
    调查阶段时玩家需要勘察现场，搜集线索，分析案件细节，持续4分钟
    随后便会召开『魔女审判』，届时所有存活玩家会被传唤至审判庭，此时玩家列表中能够看到『已死亡玩家』 *已死亡玩家的尸体再被发现时不再触发调查阶段*
    在庭上，玩家需要讨论出可能的凶手，并利用每轮讨论的投票环节票选出嫌疑人
    在庭审过程中累积得最高票两次的玩家/超时投票中得最高票的玩家将被『处刑』 *被随机的处刑装置进行处刑后，玩家死亡*

5. cam5
    『囚庭演定』便是这样一个以你的视角，经历一次次的案件、一次次审判，并亲自走到一切尽头的故事...
    玩家出局后，除了观赏这场荒谬的『悖演』外
    亦可在大厅通过参与『悖演间憩』获取『悖演残响』，以购买一些『超自然力量』，干涉局内仍存活的玩家
    啊...下班时间到了呢，那么我就先告辞了...

##组件头
#魔耗
scoreboard players remove @s MP 60
#cd
scoreboard players set @s cd2 120

#初始化射线计数
scoreboard players set @s raycast_distance 0

tag @s add swap_user

execute at @s positioned ~ ~1.6 ~ run function magics:effection/9_turn/magic9b_cast_step
execute at @s run playsound minecraft:block.enchantment_table.use player @a[distance=..30] ~ ~ ~

tag @s remove swap_user

# 给目标实体添加标记，用于后续识别
tag @s add swap_target

# 在目标当前位置生成临时marker，记录目标位置
summon marker ~ ~0.2 ~ {Tags:["swap_target_pos"]}

# 在施法者位置生成临时marker，记录施法者位置  
execute as @p[tag=swap_user] at @s run summon marker ~ ~0.2 ~ {Tags:["swap_user_pos"]}

# 传送目标实体到施法者的原位置
execute as @e[type=marker,tag=swap_user_pos,limit=1] at @s run tp @e[tag=swap_target,limit=1] ~ ~ ~

# 传送施法者到目标的原位置
execute as @e[type=marker,tag=swap_target_pos,limit=1] at @s run tp @p[tag=swap_user] ~ ~ ~

# 清理标记和临时marker
tag @s remove swap_target
kill @e[type=marker,tag=swap_target_pos]
kill @e[type=marker,tag=swap_user_pos]

# 特效和声音
particle minecraft:portal ~ ~ ~ 0.5 1 0.5 0 20 force
execute as @p[tag=swap_user] at @s run particle minecraft:portal ~ ~ ~ 0.5 1 0.5 0 20 force
playsound entity.enderman.teleport ambient @a ~ ~ ~ 1.0
execute as @p[tag=swap_user] at @s run playsound entity.enderman.teleport ambient @a ~ ~ ~ 1.0

particle minecraft:portal ~ ~ ~ 0 0 0 0 1 force

execute positioned ~-0.5 ~-0.5 ~-0.5 if entity @a[dx=0,dy=0,dz=0,tag=!swap_user,nbt={DeathTime:0s},gamemode=adventure] run scoreboard players add @s raycast_distance 128
execute positioned ~-0.5 ~-0.5 ~-0.5 as @a[dx=0,dy=0,dz=0,tag=!swap_user,nbt={DeathTime:0s},gamemode=adventure] run function magics:effection/9_turn/magic9b_cast_at

scoreboard players add @s raycast_distance 1

execute unless block ~ ~ ~ #minecraft:air run return 0

execute if score @s raycast_distance matches 30.. run return 0

# ===== 如果没有碰到障碍物，继续前进 =====
execute positioned ^ ^ ^1 run function magics:effection/9_turn/magic9b_cast_step

# 待办

~~感觉这些做成魔法也可以~~

~~好难想啊~~

最好是那种，初见莫名其妙死掉，在知道功能之后还有可玩性的道具

### <font color=red>死亡笔记</font>

可以选一个人杀死，红色道具吧

### <font color=purple>巫毒娃娃</font>

可以选一个人绑定，自己死后那个人也死

### <font color=orange>妖刀</font>

拿在手上时如果附近五米内有人，自动斩杀附近五米所有人，包括自己

### <font color=orange>画笔</font>

可以画小动物，但是会攻击所有人

**from 诺亚 BE，感觉做成魔法更合适一点**

### <font color=red>画布</font>

可以把别人困在画里，到时间解除，画布可以被销毁

**感觉可以和上面那个一起做成魔法**

~~诺亚 pro max~~

### <font color=red>纸人</font>

可以抵挡一次死亡，但是如果携带超过一定时间就会被纸人杀死

携带时间上限可以每次随机取一个

### <font color=purple>时钟</font>

使用可以大幅增加移速等，同时玩家倒计时减少

再次使用恢复原状

倒计时到零直接死亡

### <font color=orange>布袋</font>

可以收纳物品，但是当里面的物品超过一定数量时直接带着里面的物品消失

可以用原版收纳袋实现

### <font color=red>绳结</font>

指定一个人，如果在一定时间内自己没有死亡，指定的那个人就会消失

指定时对方会收到提示，同时对方能知道自己的位置

### <font color=blue>???</font>

~~还没想好叫什么~~

在一定时间内给所有人播放脚步声

有用但不多，比较好玩

### <font color=red>羽毛</font>

右键可以守护一个人，那个人死亡两次后自己消失

如果自己死了（消失等不算）那个人也会死

### <font color=orange>灵刀</font>

~~警长~~

打人时，如果对方不是魔女则自己死亡

配合 13 药使用比较好，不然还是杀不死魔女

### <font color=red>秘药</font>

喝了之后获得力量效果，但是若干秒后直接死亡

### <font color=orange>???</font>

function props_anan:effection/stun_gun/stun_paralyze with entity @e[distance=..0.5,type=!player,type=!arrow,sort=nearest,limit=1]
# 清除箭矢
kill @s

# 审判之铳 - 初始化
# 初始化弹药（2发）
scoreboard players set @s gun.ammo 2

# 初始化冷却

# 缓慢255 + 虚弱255 + 飘浮抑制跳跃 = 完全麻痹1秒
effect give @s minecraft:slowness 1 254 true
effect give @s minecraft:weakness 1 254 true
effect give @s minecraft:levitation 1 0 true

# 粒子特效（电击火花）
particle minecraft:electric_spark ~ ~1 ~ 0.3 0.5 0.3 0.1 8

playsound minecraft:entity.lightning_bolt.thunder player @a[distance=..20] ~ ~ ~ 0.3 1.5

tellraw @s {"text":"一股电流贯穿了你的身体……","color":"yellow"}

# 清理着地箭矢
kill @e[type=arrow,tag=gun_projectile,nbt={inGround:1b}]

# 重置计时器
scoreboard players set #global gun.tick_timer 0

# === 湿度更新（每20tick调度） ===
# 所有 detect/tag/sanction 全部内联，零外部函数调用

scoreboard players operation @a weather.dprog_delta = @s dwitchProg
scoreboard players operation @a weather.dprog_delta -= @s weather.dprog_snap

execute as @a[scores={weather.dprog_delta=1..}] run scoreboard players operation @s weather.humidity += @s weather.dprog_delta

scoreboard players operation @a weather.dprog_snap = @s dwitchProg

scoreboard players remove @a[scores={weather.humidity=1..}] weather.humidity 1

execute as @a[scores={weather.humidity=20..29}] run tag @s add weather.drenched
execute as @a[scores={weather.humidity=30..}] run tag @s add weather.cursed

execute if score #global weather.storm_timer_temp matches 0 as @a[tag=weather.charged,tag=!weather.drenched,tag=!weather.cursed] if predicate props_anan:random_30 if predicate props_anan:random_15 run effect give @s minecraft:slowness 100 0 true

execute store result score @s posX run data get entity @s Pos[0] 1000
execute store result score @s posY run data get entity @s Pos[1] 1000
execute store result score @s posZ run data get entity @s Pos[2] 1000

scoreboard players operation @n[type=arrow,tag=summon,tag=ticl4] posX -= @s posX

scoreboard players operation @n[type=arrow,tag=summon,tag=ticl4] posZ -= @s posZ

function talent:effection/12_ability_collector/collector


#冬萤の 光借りては 缀る文
#Fuyu inn no, hikari karite wa, tsuzuru fumi
#冬日作言困，借得毫末流萤光，拼缀虚文言

# 建立双向绑定
# 将自己的 bond_target 设置为目标的 num
scoreboard players operation @s bond_target = #target_num tmp

# 将目标的 bond_target 设置为自己的 num（limit=1 防止意外匹配多个）
execute as @a if score @s num = #target_num tmp run scoreboard players operation @s bond_target = #self_num tmp

# 提示双方绑定成功
tellraw @s {"text":"羁绊建立成功","color":"green"}
execute as @a if score @s num = #target_num tmp run tellraw @s {"text":"羁绊建立成功","color":"green"}

# 获取当前死亡次数
execute store result score #current_death tmp run scoreboard players get @s deathCount
# 获取上次记录的死亡次数
execute store result score #last_death tmp run scoreboard players get @s last_death

# 检测到死亡：先标记 death_triggered 防止重复触发，再执行同归于尽
execute if score #current_death tmp > #last_death tmp run scoreboard players set @s death_triggered 1
execute if score #current_death tmp > #last_death tmp run function talent:effection/13_ability_soul_bond/on_death

# 更新上次记录值
scoreboard players operation @s last_death = #current_death tmp

# 防止循环
execute store result score #target_num tmp run scoreboard players get @s bind_trigger
scoreboard players set @s bind_trigger 0

# 验证目标序号有效性
execute unless score #target_num tmp matches 1..20 run return 0

# 获取自己的 num
execute store result score #self_num tmp run scoreboard players get @s num

# 禁止绑定自己
execute if score #target_num tmp = #self_num tmp run tellraw @s {"text":"不能绑定自己","color":"red"}
execute if score #target_num tmp = #self_num tmp run return 0

# 检查目标玩家是否在线
execute store result score #target_online tmp if entity @a if score @s num = #target_num tmp
execute unless score #target_online tmp matches 1 run tellraw @s {"text":"目标玩家不在线","color":"red"}
execute unless score #target_online tmp matches 1 run return 0

execute unless score @s bond_target matches 1.. run function talent:effection/13_ability_soul_bond/bind_logic

execute if score @s bond_target matches 1.. run tellraw @s {"text":"你已经绑定过了","color":"red"}

scoreboard players set @s TalentSort 13
# 显示可绑定列表
function talent:effection/13_ability_soul_bond/show_list

# 获取绑定目标的 num
execute store result score #target_num tmp run scoreboard players get @s bond_target

# 标记对方为已触发（防止对方死亡后反向击杀），再杀死对方
execute as @a if score @s num = #target_num tmp run scoreboard players set @s death_triggered 1
execute as @a if score @s num = #target_num tmp run kill @s

# 确保 death_triggered 记分板存在
execute unless score #death_init tmp matches 1 run scoreboard objectives add death_triggered dummy
execute unless score #death_init tmp matches 1 run scoreboard players set #death_init tmp 1

# 检查玩家是否真的死亡（Health<=0 即为死亡，entity_hurt_player触发时玩家可能只是受伤）
execute store result score #health_check tmp run data get entity @s Health 1.0
execute if score #health_check tmp matches 1.. run return 0

# 防止同一死亡多次触发
execute if score @s death_triggered matches 1 run return 0
scoreboard players set @s death_triggered 1

# 执行同归于尽
function talent:effection/13_ability_soul_bond/on_death

# 玩家重生后自动重置标记（Health>0 说明已重生）
execute as @a[scores={death_triggered=1}] store result score #reset_check tmp run data get entity @s Health 1.0
execute as @a[scores={death_triggered=1}] if score #reset_check tmp matches 1.. run scoreboard players reset @s death_triggered

scoreboard players add @s task_count 1
execute store result score #self_num tmp run scoreboard players get @s num
execute store result score #self_count tmp run scoreboard players get @s task_count
execute store result score #target_num tmp run scoreboard players get @s bond_target

# 为目标玩家打标签并获取其任务计数
execute as @a if score @s num = #target_num tmp run tag @s add target_temp
execute as @a[tag=target_temp] store result score #target_count tmp run scoreboard players get @s task_count

# 清除临时标签（精准清除）
tag @a[tag=target_temp] remove target_temp

# 判断双方任务数是否都 >= 3，且自己未领奖
execute if score #self_count tmp matches 3.. if score #target_count tmp matches 3.. if score @s reward_given matches 0 run tag @s add ready_reward

# 给自己发奖
execute as @s[tag=ready_reward] run function talent:effection/13_ability_soul_bond/reward_helper
execute as @s[tag=ready_reward] run scoreboard players set @s reward_given 1

# 给对方发奖（如果对方也没领过）
execute as @a if score @s num = #target_num tmp if score @s reward_given matches 0 run tag @s add target_ready
execute as @a[tag=target_ready] run function talent:effection/13_ability_soul_bond/reward_helper
execute as @a[tag=target_ready] run scoreboard players set @s reward_given 1

# 清理标签（精准清除）
tag @s remove ready_reward
tag @a[tag=target_ready] remove target_ready

$function talent:icon/type/$(num)

scoreboard players set @a bow 1

scoreboard players set @s gourmet_range 0
scoreboard players set @s gourmet_speed 0
scoreboard players set @s gourmet_attack 0
scoreboard players set @s gourmet_health 0

scoreboard players set @s vacumm_active 0

scoreboard players set @s TalentSort 0

##desc storage refresh

$execute if entity @a[scores={ready=1,TalentSort=$(talent_test)}] run return fail

$scoreboard players set @s TalentSort $(talent_test)

data remove storage talent:data talent_test

execute if entity @a[scores={ready=1,dead=0,TalentSort=0}] run schedule function talent:select/talent_assign 1t

execute store result storage talent:data talent_test int 1.0 run random value 1..21

execute as @s run function talent:select/random_macro with storage talent:data

scoreboard players set @a TalentSort 0
data remove storage talent:data talent_test

# 天赋模块
    天赋文件夹：talent(旧天赋已被毙掉)
## 模块类型说明
1. 目前天赋暂定为两大类型：
   - 道具类天赋 ：
     * 天赋附加作用道具(addition) ：所有玩家均可能拥有，但是天赋者可发挥出其他作用**请将该类道具分类为talent_props** 
   - 能力类天赋(ability) ：带有额外能力，或主动或被动
2. 编写新天赋之前请在同目录下的**天赋列表.md**下为你的天赋标号、署名，并简洁的描述你的天赋内容，以便于总览
    * 例：3. 3_addition_chivalrous(侠之大者) 制作者:m_tiao 效果:初始携带「弓」，且使用「弓」时将以血量上限抵抗负面效果，并可以触发「弓」的天赋效果
   - 抽取天赋将直接依靠数字编号 (*计分板<TalentSort>)运行，只有游戏重置时会重新分配天赋编号
   - 编写新天赋之前请创建talent_give/give.mcfunction中为新天赋添加调用接口
   - 并以 **tellraw @s "「XXXX」"** （你想的很对，强制四个字命名）为开端，并额外添加光标悬浮以介绍背景，然后附加简洁介绍（文本颜色暂未严格规定）
    * 例：
     **3_addition_chivalrous/give.mcfunction:**
   **tellraw @s [{text:"「侠之大者」",color:"#a0abce","bold":true,hover_event:{action:"show_text","value":{text:"「",color:"#8fc4b8"}}}]**
     * 此处为天赋名称和悬浮文本（天赋背景）
   **tellraw @s [{"text":"你初始携带「弓」，且你使用「弓」时将以血量上限抵抗负面效果，并可以触发「弓」的特殊效果","color":"#a0abce"}]**
     * 此处为聊天栏文本（简洁介绍）
3. 编写时可在advancemnet或function文件夹下创建子文件夹如："1_'类型’+'天赋名'"，如 **"1_common_parry"**
  - 对于道具类 ：
      - 请在个人文件夹内编写该道具常态作用，于天赋文件夹编写特殊检测函数，并于常态作用的effection里调用
      - 请在天赋道具分类(talent_props)下方增添备注：**该道具具有特殊作用，需要天赋「XXXX」（天赋名）解锁**
  - 对于能力类 ：
      请直接于天赋子文件夹内编写

4. **所有天赋均需要于子文件夹内编写"give.mcfunction"**,内容可以是一些计分板数值的初始化或道具给予
      - 天赋的赋予方法统一为使用TalentSort分配的序号，无需个人添加标签

5. 请在**reset.mcfunction**内加入游戏重启时需要重置的内容，

6. 关于计分板创建，可于scoreboard/scoreborad_init.mcfunction中编写，并按照对应天赋分类，具体格式请自行参照

7. 请在icon/type下按序号添加天赋图标(item_model)及描述(lore)，格式参考icon/type/6

## 任务组件

**ps: 1 游戏日内最多触发 3 次通常任务，3 次后将触发“回到牢房”任务**

### 任务流程（依次）

判定 [ 集体任务 ] 是否触发 **-(若否)->** 分配任务 **->** 随机种类 **->** 随机序号 **->[** ~~协同检定(多玩家分配同一任务,共享完成条件)~~ **]->** 任务完成鉴定(自调用进程)

## 任务种类

0. default
1. 群体任务（所有人共享）-group
2. 调查任务（完成依赖放大镜） -survey
3. 探索触发任务（踩点完成） -explore
4. 想去做任务（完成相应行为） -wannado
 
## 具体任务

### 1. 调查

#### 1. 调查图书馆
从图书馆预设的 **[任务调查点位]** 中随机抽选一个作为完成任务的条件

#### 2. 找药
从医务室预设的 **[任务调查点位]** 中随机抽选一个作为完成任务的条件
